Cors._comment: DEV ONLY. The Vite dev server's default origin. It is a list because Vite moves to the next free port (5174, 5175, ...) when 5173 is already taken - add the extra origins here if you run more than one front end at a time.

Jwt._SigningKey_comment: No value here on purpose, not even a placeholder. This file is tracked, so a key written here is a published key: anyone reading the repository could mint user and game tokens against any instance that ends up running as Development. Set it per machine with: dotnet user-secrets --project AscendantEmpire.Api set "Jwt:SigningKey" "<32+ random characters>". Startup fails with an explicit message when it is missing.

ConnectionStrings._comment: DEV ONLY, and deliberately machine-neutral - LocalDB is present with the Visual Studio and SQL Server Express installs, so a fresh clone runs without editing a tracked file. Point it somewhere else without touching this file: dotnet user-secrets --project AscendantEmpire.Api set "ConnectionStrings:AscendantEmpireDatabase" "<your connection string>". User-secrets load after this file in Development, so they win.

ExportSettings._TempDirectory_comment: Deliberately unset, so no one machine's disk layout is committed. Falls back to <system temp>/AscendantEmpire/Exports. Override per machine with user-secrets or the ExportSettings__TempDirectory environment variable.

MapGenerationSettings._OutputDirectory_comment: Deliberately unset, so no one machine's disk layout is committed. Falls back to <system temp>/AscendantEmpire/MapPreviews. Override per machine with user-secrets or the MapGenerationSettings__OutputDirectory environment variable.
